premise: The beach wakes up: the waves breathe, the sun comes up over the bay and, one by one, everyone opens their eyes.
inspiration: The folk 'waking world' morning song (the cock crows, the farm wakes), turned to a beach where the sea itself breathes everyone awake.

en-US.title: Good Morning, Beach
en-US.text: [softly] {all:face sleeping} Shhh. The beach is still asleep. {sfx:waves} Swish… swoosh… the little waves roll in, one after another, as if the sea is breathing. [short pause] {canvas:sunshine 0.7 30s} Then the sun comes up over the bay, warm and gold. {all:glow 0.4} It touches every shell and every pebble. Far away, a bird calls. {sfx:gull solo} {all:face surprised} Who's that? Eyes blink open. One. Two. Three. {all:face happy} {all:hop} Good morning, sand! {all:wobble} Good morning, waves! Good morning, lighthouse, keeping watch across the bay! [happily] {all:sparkle 0.4} The water sparkles. The sand is warm. {all:hearts} And the whole beach, all together, is ready to play.

es-ES.title: Buenos días, playa
es-ES.text: [softly] {all:face sleeping} Chist. La playa todavía duerme. {sfx:waves} Chas… chas… llegan las olas pequeñitas, una detrás de otra, como si el mar respirara. [short pause] {canvas:sunshine 0.7 30s} Entonces sale el sol sobre la bahía, cálido y dorado. {all:glow 0.4} Toca cada concha y cada piedrecita. A lo lejos, llama un pájaro. {sfx:gull solo} {all:face surprised} ¿Quién será? Los ojos se abren. Uno. Dos. Tres. {all:face happy} {all:hop} ¡Buenos días, arena! {all:wobble} ¡Buenos días, olas! ¡Buenos días, faro, que vigilas al otro lado de la bahía! [happily] {all:sparkle 0.4} El agua brilla. La arena está calentita. {all:hearts} Y toda la playa, todos juntos, está lista para jugar.

waves.prompt: gentle small waves lapping on a sandy beach at dawn, calm, realistic field recording

gull.prompt: a single seagull calling once far away over the sea, realistic field recording
